title: Stage transition equation for restricted affine complexes
statement: For any preorder-indexed diagram D over S, coefficient family F and transition maps phi, degree p and etale U, the concrete scheme map and degree-zero complex transition of [def-sbc-restricted-affine-single-maps] and [def-sbc-restricted-affine-coefficient-construction] induce exactly the canonical restricted-cohomology map of [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology]. The comparisons are identities for these fixed constructions; no arbitrary complexes, transitions or comparison isomorphisms are quantified over.

proof.text: Unfold restrictedAffineDiagram, restrictedAffineK and restrictedAffineSingleTransition. The two morphism expressions coincide definitionally with rawAffineRestrictedCohomologyMap; reflexivity proves the equation for every stage arrow. No cohomology computation or invertibility assumption is needed.

statement_change.old_statement: For the concrete restricted affine coefficient witnesses, the stage cohomology comparison intertwines the complex transition with the canonical restricted cohomology map.
statement_change.what: The former Lean signature allowed arbitrary Dprime, K, psi and r without identifying the advertised concrete witnesses. For two stages with identical groups and maps, taking r to be identity at one stage and a swap at the other forces id = swap. The first repair rCanonical with r = rCanonical was vacuous because rCanonical was unconstrained. Use the actual diagram, complexes and transition; their comparisons are identities.
